list.name: segment
list.label: Segment
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT metric_json->>'segment' AS segment FROM metrics WHERE metric_json IS NOT NULL AND metric_json->>'segment' IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1;

list.name: project
list.label: Project
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT project FROM metrics WHERE project IS NOT NULL AND (CASE WHEN COALESCE('$segment','') = '' THEN TRUE ELSE metric_json->>'segment' = '$segment' END) ORDER BY 1;

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(avg_val)::numeric,3) AS maturity FROM (SELECT time_bucket('7 days', observed_at) AS tb, AVG(COALESCE(score, metric_value)) AS avg_val FROM metrics WHERE metric_key='overall_maturity_score' AND $__timeFilter(observed_at) AND (CASE WHEN COALESCE('$segment','') = '' THEN TRUE ELSE metric_json->>'segment' = '$segment' END) AND (CASE WHEN COALESCE('${project:csv}','') = '' THEN TRUE ELSE project IN (${project:csv}) END) GROUP BY tb ORDER BY tb DESC LIMIT 1) t;

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status='succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 1) AS success_rate FROM runs WHERE COALESCE(finished_at, started_at) >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' AND (CASE WHEN COALESCE('${project:csv}','') = '' THEN TRUE ELSE project IN (${project:csv}) END);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (finished_at - started_at)))/60.0, 1) AS avg_min FROM runs WHERE finished_at IS NOT NULL AND started_at IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(finished_at, started_at) >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' AND (CASE WHEN COALESCE('${project:csv}','') = '' THEN TRUE ELSE project IN (${project:csv}) END);

WITH periods AS (SELECT project, time_bucket('30 days', observed_at) AS bucket, AVG(COALESCE(score, metric_value)) AS v FROM metrics WHERE metric_key='overall_maturity_score' AND $__timeFilter(observed_at) AND (CASE WHEN COALESCE('$segment','') = '' THEN TRUE ELSE metric_json->>'segment' = '$segment' END) GROUP BY project, bucket), curr AS (SELECT project, v FROM periods WHERE bucket >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'), prev AS (SELECT project, v FROM periods WHERE bucket < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' AND bucket >= NOW() - INTERVAL '60 days') SELECT COALESCE(curr.project, prev.project) AS project, ROUND(COALESCE(curr.v,0) - COALESCE(prev.v,0), 3) AS delta FROM curr FULL OUTER JOIN prev ON curr.project = prev.project WHERE (CASE WHEN COALESCE('${project:csv}','') = '' THEN TRUE ELSE COALESCE(curr.project, prev.project) IN (${project:csv}) END) ORDER BY delta DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

WITH periods AS (SELECT project, time_bucket('30 days', observed_at) AS bucket, AVG(COALESCE(score, metric_value)) AS v FROM metrics WHERE metric_key='overall_maturity_score' AND $__timeFilter(observed_at) AND (CASE WHEN COALESCE('$segment','') = '' THEN TRUE ELSE metric_json->>'segment' = '$segment' END) GROUP BY project, bucket), curr AS (SELECT project, v FROM periods WHERE bucket >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'), prev AS (SELECT project, v FROM periods WHERE bucket < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' AND bucket >= NOW() - INTERVAL '60 days') SELECT COALESCE(curr.project, prev.project) AS project, ROUND(COALESCE(curr.v,0) - COALESCE(prev.v,0), 3) AS delta FROM curr FULL OUTER JOIN prev ON curr.project = prev.project WHERE (CASE WHEN COALESCE('${project:csv}','') = '' THEN TRUE ELSE COALESCE(curr.project, prev.project) IN (${project:csv}) END) ORDER BY delta ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

options.content: Use this view to capture the last 30 days summary: maturity trend, success rate, average duration, top improvers/decliners. Export panels as PNG for slides.
